principles: Enable RLS on public tables before exposing them through anon or authenticated API roles.
Use explicit TO anon or TO authenticated clauses, not auth.role() predicates.
Do not use TO authenticated by itself as authorization; include an organisation, transaction, assignment, or admin predicate.
Prefer existing helpers such as bridge_is_active_member, bridge_is_org_admin, bridge_has_workspace_permission, and bridge_has_transaction_permission before adding new helpers.
Keep internal control, sequence, diagnostic, and financial writes off direct browser access unless a specific UI workflow proves otherwise.
